lina: Quick ops summary: Conduit streaming GA finished roll at 19:41 UTC. Small follow-ups below. :tada:

lina: TL;DR: endpoints stable, slight spike in tail latencies for orgs with many small streams. We increased prewarm and tuned batching windows.

tom: Noted the tail. We adjusted batch time from 12ms -> 8ms in us-east to reduce M90. Will monitor.

ops_oncall: Prewarm logs show retries for ~2% of connections in eu-west between 19:30-19:38. Reduced after proxy config tweak. Saved logs to S3 for analysis.

lina: Action: infra to add a probe that simulates 50 concurrent mobile streams every 5m. tom, can you own the probe?

tom: On it. I'll post PR to infra/probes and tag @ops_oncall.

devx-bot: note: SDK patch published: python-sdk@3.8.1 (conduit streaming fixed socket close). Node patch queued.

security: We validated streaming HMAC v2 rollout. No anomalies. Reminder: customers using long-lived streams should rotate keys if you detect connection churn.

lina: Mini migration note for product teams: legacy generate endpoints will remain for 60 days. New customers should use /v1/conduit/generate with `stream:true`. Example minimal curl: curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"conduit-13b","stream":true,"input":"hi"}' https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/conduit/generate

deploy-bot: deploy: hosted/conduit/gateway v1.0.2 deployed by CI at 2026-07-12T19:42:10Z  roll complete.

lina: Thanks all. Filing follow-ups: infra-probe (P0), analyze eu-west retries (P1), mobile SDK sample apps (P2). Tag issues with `conduit-ga`.
